Standard practice delivers a DESIGN CHANGE (material modification to kink resistance) by reinforcing tubing locally.  
My same-class mechanism departs by introducing a geometric relief feature at the luer interface that redistributes strain.  
This works because kink occlusion occurs from localized plastic deformation; the relief feature distributes stress below the yield point.

Governing relation: Strain distribution at bend radius ε = t/(2R), where t is wall thickness, R is bend radius.
